_readme: Ticket agents (lib/ticket_agents.py). mode: auto = propose until act_after, then act | propose | act | off. agents: per-agent override. stale_claims and refeed stay on 'propose' until you change them here: releasing claims can re-queue tickets that were deliberately held, and refeed opens a second PR beside the denied one. A ticket labelled pinned is never touched; held also protects its claim.
